zzz:Phoenix.title: Phoenix Reffaella · S-Rank · Fire Anomaly
text: First mentioned at the climax of Version 2.8's main story, Phoenix finally walked on screen in 3.2 with a comic scene players still bring up.
In 3.3, "Journey to the Sky", she is at the centre of the main story: she and Severian, Seth Lowell's brother, head for the occupied skyport on Quietude Isle, and the two end up on opposite sides.

wuwa:Suoming.title: Seal Master of the Ten Seals Covenant · 5★ Electro · Sword
text: Suoming's first scene closed Version 3.6: Yinlin had just put down the Takgyun Hall gang when Suoming appeared behind her with a cryptic message.
She is the Seal Master of Mengzhou, the region 3.5 opened, and became playable in Phase II of 3.7 with her sword, Unspoken Rue.

endfield:Si.title: Feranmut Proxy
text: Teased since Version 1.2, Si arrives offering to treat the Endministrator and leads them into Yuanyuan Manor, a world she painted into being herself.
In battle she is a support who also deals her own damage; her operator story tells the rest.

art.scene_caption: Inside Si's painting, the story's new zone

nte:Akane Rin.title: S-Class · guitarist and lead vocalist of The Whoots!!!!
text: Akane Rin first played the StarSign live house in the side story "A Legendary(?) Band's First Page" — guitar and lead vocals for The Whoots!!!!, and the same electric guitar is her weapon.
She joined for NTE's half-year anniversary on October 21, when the school-festival story has the band cover "God Knows..." at Clement Academy's 100th-anniversary concert.

genshin:Skirk.title: Childe's master · Cryo · Sword
text: Skirk is the swordswoman who taught Tartaglia to survive when he fell into the Abyss as a child — a disciple of Surtalogi, one of the Five Sinners of Khaenri'ah, who has never sided with the Abyss Order.
She first became playable in Version 5.7 (June 2025); October's banner was her rerun.

hsr:Mortenax Blade.title: Blade, reborn · 5★ Fire · Nihility
text: Mortenax Blade is a new form of the Stellaron Hunter Blade, the swordsman long afflicted by mara, who debuted with Version 4.3, "The Lethe Below the Living" (June 2026).
In that chapter of Planarcadia he and the Trailblazer take separate roads into the World in Canvas, both leading to the shadow of Lord Ravager Asat Pramad. October's banner was his rerun.
